title: GF2 VR Settings
subtitle: Review and save VR settings. Start the game manually.
renderSummary: These are saved settings. Effective VR values are determined after restarting the game. PC and auxiliary-panel resolution stay independent.
navigationSummary: Default: left stick moves / right stick turns. Selecting the other hand swaps both roles. Panel, pointer and button roles stay independent.
conflictHelp: Left Grip is reserved for the auxiliary panel, which takes priority. Trigger on UI prioritizes UI interaction. Enable at least one activation button and one tracked hand.
availabilityHelp:
This window provides render scale, Stereo Depth, stick movement/turning and World Drag settings read by the installed mod.

A/B–X/Y swap: persisted control is connected only in a separate development build, so this window does not change it.

Activity primary UI: its display issue is being investigated. A toggle is not available yet. The existing auxiliary panel remains usable.

Camera-follow toggle, world scale, linked depth/speed, panel placement and pointer options will be added after runtime integration.

VFX remains at Game Default. Independent effect controls are unverified, so no effect switches are offered. AA improvement is outside the current scope.
restart: Close the game before saving. Restart it manually to apply changes. Saving does not prove VR application. Numbers accept a decimal point (.) or exponent notation.
renderHelp: Neutral/default 1.0; development trial 0.6. At 0.6 the pixel count is about 36% of 1.0. No validated recommended range yet; entry is unrestricted. Device limits may reject application.
depthHelp: Neutral/default 1.0 = 100%. Calculation-tested guidance 0.5–1.5, not a limit or comfort guarantee. Changes game-world eye separation, not the headset’s physical IPD.
handHelp: Default left. The other hand handles turning.
modeHelp: Default snap. Choose smooth for continuous view turning.
speedHelp: Default 1.0. Recommended range unconfirmed. Negative or nonfinite values cannot be applied.
multiplierHelp: Neutral/default 1.0. Configured speed = speed × multiplier. This does not change world scale.
snapHelp: Default 30°. 15/30/45/60° are suggested choices; other angles remain editable.
smoothHelp: Default 60. Not used while snap mode is selected.
deadzoneHelp: Default 0.2. Input normalization requires 0 ≤ value < 1; this is a semantic constraint, not a recommended-range clamp.
dragHelp: Default OFF. Choose activation buttons and tracked hands. Actual files stay unchanged until saved.
resetQuestion: Select defaults? Actual files change only when you press Save.
folderHelp: Select the game installation folder containing GF2 Game.
